description: PLUi de Rennes Métropole : plan thématique : risques mouvements de terrain is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Ces secteurs recensent les zones relatives aux mouvements de terrain (plan thématique). Ces prescriptions réglementaires s'appliquent zones concernées par le retrait/gonflement des sols argileux (aléas forts et/ou moyen). Elles concernent aussi les zones concernées par tout effondrement lié aux carrières souterraines (aléas fort, aléas moyen). Coverage: Rennes Métropole en accès libre. The publisher named on the listing is Rennes Métropole en accès libre. Its keywords include document-durbanisme, urbanisme. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2019-10-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
